items.title: National Chambal Sanctuary
items.text: Pristine river ecosystem situated 45 km from Sawai Madhopur at Palighat.

items.title: Critically Endangered Gharials
items.text: Home to the world’s largest breeding population of long-snouted Gharials.

items.title: Marsh Mugger Crocodiles
items.text: Spot massive marsh crocodiles basking silently on sandy river islets.

items.title: UNESCO 10th-Century Fort Trek
items.text: Explore Trinetra Ganesha Temple, 7 colossal stone gates, and ancient stepwells.

blocks.heading: Aquatic Wildlife of the Chambal River
blocks.intro: One of the cleanest and most biodiversity-rich river sanctuaries in Asia.

items.title: Gharial (Gavialis gangeticus)
items.text: Prehistoric fish-eating crocodilians with slender snouts swimming gracefully in clear waters.

items.title: Mugger Crocodile
items.text: Powerful broad-snouted apex predators sunbathing along rocky shores.

items.title: Gangetic River Dolphin
items.text: Rare freshwater mammals surfacing for breaths in deep river channels.

items.title: Indian Skimmers & Waterfowl
items.text: Over 300 bird species including Bar-headed geese and Sarus Cranes.

blocks.heading: UNESCO World Heritage Ranthambore Fort
blocks.intro: Perched atop a 700-foot sheer cliff within the core tiger reserve, this fortress dates back to 944 AD. Hike through massive stone gates, admire 360-degree views of Padam Talao below, and pay homage at the revered Trinetra Ganesha Temple.

items.title: Trinetra Ganesha
items.text: Ancient 3-eyed Ganesha temple receiving wedding invitations from across India daily.

items.title: Panoramic Lake Views
items.text: Look down from high stone ramparts directly into Zone 3 and spot wild deer & tigers.

items.title: Rajput Architecture
items.text: Intricate stone cenotaphs (chhatris), ancient stepwells, and Badal Mahal ruins.

blocks.heading: Chambal & Fort FAQs
blocks.intro: Helpful tips for planning your river and fort day tour.

items.q: How far is the Chambal River safari from Ranthambore?
items.a: The boarding point at Palighat is approximately 45 km (about 1 hour scenic drive) from Sawai Madhopur.

items.q: How long is the Chambal boat ride?
items.a: The motorboat safari lasts approximately 1 to 1.5 hours along the calm, tranquil river. Life jackets are provided.

items.q: Can we combine Chambal boating with Ranthambore Fort in a single day?
items.a: Yes! A morning Chambal river cruise followed by an afternoon visit to Ranthambore Fort is our most popular day combo.

blocks.title: Book Chambal Boating & Fort Excursion
blocks.text: Complete private package including sanitized AC cab, driver, forest boat tickets, and guide. Speak with our local desk to reserve your excursion.

seo.title: Chambal River Safari & Ranthambore Fort Day Tour
seo.description: Cruise the National Chambal Sanctuary to spot Gharials, mugger crocodiles and river dolphins, then trek the UNESCO 10th-century Ranthambore Fort in one day.
seo.keywords: Chambal river safari, Chambal boat ride, Ranthambore Fort tour, Gharial sanctuary, Palighat boating, Trinetra Ganesha Temple
